title: In Jolt, PhysicsBody3D move_and_collide will slide and not collide for some collision angles
body:
### Tested versions

4.5beta5, Jolt Physics

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta5 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6119) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.84 GiB memory

### Issue description

I have been stuck for an hour wondering why my projectiles did not splashed on the ground, but would splash on walls, sometimes:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5979ed8b-db08-483e-a316-197cafa65619


### Steps to reproduce

I made a MRP where I throw a ball on a box and, I was able to replicate the issue below. 

Note that the code is meant to print "collision info!" if `move_and_collide` returns something:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/64e8cd83-80b1-4ba7-a24d-c8eb09b79cef

In the first scene, where the collision is on a horizontal surface, `move_and_collide` does not return anything ("collision info!" is not printed) and the ball slides. In the second scene where the collisionis on a vertical surface, `move_and_collide` returns something and "collision info!" is printed in the console.

Note:
- when using the `visible collision shape` debugging option, we can see the red gizmo of the collision in the `test_flat` scene
- when using `Godot Physics`, the collision is detected, and the ball slides
- when using checking the box `Solver/Custom Integrator`, the collision is detected and the ball stops


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[bug-report-01_move-and-collide.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22048351/bug-report-01_move-and-collide.zip)
